outcome: Rate of caesarean section for breech presentation
cohort: Women with breech presentation who attended either the ECV Clinic or the Breech Clinic
finding: A dedicated service to counsel women on the management of breech presentation can decrease caesarean sections for breech presentation through increased uptake and success of ECV, and encouraging suitable women to opt for VBD.
mod_finding: The introduction of a Breech Clinic decreased caesarean sections for breech presentation and increased the rate of vaginal breech delivery.
